newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH TRADE DELEGATION TO VISIT UKRAINE.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH TRADE DELEGATION TO VISIT UKRAINE.

text.p: Dutch junior minister of economic affairs Anneke van Kok will head a trade delegation leaving on June 22 for a three-day visit to Ukraine, her ministry said on Thursday.
"The visit ... will be aimed at stepping up bilateral economic relations and studying possibilities of financing commercial projects in particular," the ministry said.
Van Dok will be accompanied by a trade delegation with representatives of 18 companies and six financial institutions.
The ministry said Dutch exports to Ukraine were still relatively limited with a 1996 total of 372 million guilders.

The ministry added exports were increasing at a fast rate. The 1996 exports figure implied a 36 percent rise compared with the year-earlier total. In 1995 and 1994, exports to Ukraine surged by 50 and 15 percent respectively.
